notes.body: Regarding the spelling of "signaling" versus "signalling": "Signaling" is the correct spelling of the word in US English, and "signalling" is correct in UK English.  Which is the spelling used in the PTP specification?  Since they are both "correct" -- in a sense -- we should probably just follow whatever the specification uses.
PTP says SIGNALING, that's why I changed it.
Cool, thanks for confirming, and thanks for taking the time to clean it up to be consistent with the spec.
